retry_cuda_oom_decorator: retry a torch function automatically on CUDA out of memory by clearing cache and falling back to CPU
ignore_cuda_oom_context: create a context manager that silently ignores PyTorch CUDA out of memory exceptions
convert_tensors_to_cpu: convert CUDA tensors to CPU float32 tensors when GPU memory is exhausted
wrap_stateless_torch_function: wrap a stateless PyTorch callable to handle CUDA OOM with automatic retry logic
disable_autocast_on_cpu_retry: disable torch.cuda.amp.autocast when retrying a function on CPU after CUDA OOM
